summary: Vesta Real Estate Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting an underwriting agreement for a follow-on offering of 11,992,850 ADSs (each representing 10 common shares) with a 30-day greenshoe option for up to 10,507,140 additional ADSs. Barclays, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley are joint bookrunners. The filing does not disclose pricing terms, price per share, premium, or implied value. This is a routine capital raise (follow-on offering) by the issuer, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The transaction is an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing F-3 registration statement. No board recommendation or advisor is named beyond the underwriters. The offering is expected to close promptly per standard underwriting mechanics. Watch for pricing and market reception; no risk-arb angle applies.
